summary: Only a tnlandforms list entry names a tower at Lilesville. No source found describes a lookout there, so no story was written.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms lists a Lilesville tower entry in Anson County, with coordinates
TopoQuest's 'Lookout (historical)' in Anson County is a populated place, not a tower
evidence.quote: Lookout (historical) is a populated place located in Anson County, NC

notes_for_editor: No story written: the only tower evidence is the tnlandforms list entry, and its fifth column (nr EC1274) is unexplained. Searches (one general, one Former Fire Lookout Sites query) found no lookout tower or register entry at Lilesville. The TopoQuest 'Lookout (historical)' record in Anson County is a populated place, not a tower. Lilesville is also the name of a town, so the list entry may be a name-only record. The NHLR North Carolina list (31 registered lookouts) does not include it. Suggest a human check whether this record should stay visible.
